items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: My brother Ulysse was married with a nice widow who had six children.

ctx.x: We left New York by train the 15th of April and arrived in Cincinnati the next morning. My father and brother met us at the station and they were both looking good and happy. Lily made a hit with them the same as she had done with the rest of my friends and I was very proud of her. Later in the day, we went to visit my mother and step-father who had taken Lily to their hearts as soon as they saw her. The last time I had seen my parents brother and sister was in 1947 which was six years before this meeting and we…

My brother Ulysse was married with a nice widow who had six children. Her name was Zola. My sister Thelma had separated from her husband and was living with my father. Lily and I also stayed with Dad and Lily started

calling him Dad, which he enjoyed very much. We were in Cincy from the 16th of April until the 23rd of May and were invited to parties at least four times a week by friends of my family and some of my old musician friends that included Clarence Paige, his wife Ellen, William Smythe, who was William Smythe who was William Smith or just plain Smittie when we worked together in the old days. My sister and her boyfriend were friends with a young white couple named Bob and Phyl Connors who invited us to their home.…
